mapper.sql: id, device_id, channel_no, event_id, level, content::text as content, occurred_at, created_at
mapper.insert: insert into ipe_ops.device_event_log (device_id, channel_no, event_id, level, content, occurred_at, created_at) values (#{deviceId}, #{channelNo}, #{eventId}, #{level}, cast(#{content} as jsonb), #{occurredAt}, #{createdAt})
